en:
Okay, Shuichi!
Time to get super pumped for practice!
Yeah, let's do it!

<CLT=cltMIND>A piano duet...
Two people playing piano together.

<CLT=cltMIND>When I was first learning, I didn't
quite get it. But now...it feels nice.

<CLT=cltMIND>I played the low notes while Kaede played the
high. Together, we played a melody.

<CLT=cltMIND>Of course, my playing didn't compare,
but Kaede carried me.

<CLT=cltMIND>Perhaps that's what gave
it a magical sense of unity.

<CLT=cltMIND>At first, I was so focused on Kaede sitting
next to me that I couldn't focus...

<CLT=cltMIND>But as we kept playing, it got
easier. It felt perfectly natural.

<CLT=cltMIND>It's like Kaede and I...
have become one.
<CLT=cltMIND>.........
<CLT=cltMIND>......
<CLT=cltMIND>...
*sigh*

<CLT=cltMIND>After we finished playing, we remained
sitting beside one another, basking in it.

You're amazing, Shuichi. I can't believe you've
improved this much in such little time.
N-No, I'm not...

<CLT=cltMIND>No, that isn't quite what
I want to say.

I had a great teacher who showed me
the beauty of playing the piano.

The beauty of playing the piano?
What do you mean?

It's so fun to play. I understand
why you get entranced by it.

Right?
Even though it's just us here right now...

Someone might hear and it'll make them smile!
That's when you know it's worth it!

I was only able to have this great
experience because I met you, Kaede.

I know that this is an...
abnormal situation...
But I'm still so glad that I met you.

"I had a great teacher who showed me
the beauty of playing the piano."

S-Shuichi... I can't believe you said
something so embarrassing.
Huh? What?

B-But... I'm...
glad I met you.

While I was teaching you,
I was reminded of how great pianos are...

And I started to realize myself what I
can do on the piano.
Yeah...

Hey, Shuichi. When we get out of here,
come over to my house.

Huh? You mean it?
Your...house?
Of course, where else?

W-Well, it's just that...
I mean, going to your house is...

W-Wait a minute!
No, I didn't mean it like that!

I wanted us to perform our duet practice on
my favorite piano, so you could hear it!

Ah, that's what you meant!
I'm sorry, I misunderstood.

But...I also wanna talk to you,
and watch TV with you...
What?

You know how I said I wanted to become
closer to you when we got out of here?

And...if it's you...I feel like we could
get to know each other a lot more...
<CLT=cltMIND>Does that...mean...?
That's why...
That's why...?

Geez!
Just be a man and say yes already!
Ah! Sorry! Yes! Yes, yes!
...Pft!
Haha...
Hahahahaha!

We're just not there yet... With
our duet, our friendship, everything...

Which is why we're going to escape...
so we can hopefully grow together.
Yeah, you're right.

<CLT=cltMIND>I kind of understood what
Kaede was trying to say.

<CLT=cltMIND>I think that's because we have such
a strong bond between us.

<CLT=cltMIND>But when we get out of here...
I might want to take this even further...

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Kaede's <CLT=cltSTRONG>Report Card<CLT=cltSYSTEM> has been updated
based on your experience with her.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>You've learned a new skill,
<CLT=cltSTRONG>Piano Duet<CLT=cltSYSTEM>.

<CLT=cltMIND>Kaede and I spent the rest of the day
talking about what to do after we escape.
